items.title: The Syrian Observatory for Human Rights reports that groups attributed to the Syrian Ministry of Defense have killed over 750 Alawite civilians across several massacres in western Syria.

British Prime Minister David Cameron announces that two engineers – Briton Chris McManus and Italian Franco Lamolinara – who were abducted by Islamic extremists in Nigeria in May 2011 were killed during a rescue attempt by British and Nigerian forces.
Federal Reserve rate decision: cut by 0.25 point, to a target of 6.00% (effective 1991-03-08)
Geomagnetic storm G5 (extreme) on 8 March 1970: Kp reached 9
